answer: New identities start on the lowest terrace: only tiny trades until they have dealt with many counterparties. A sybil tide of a hundred hollow accounts looks busy, but every trade loops inside one cluster, so their diversity score stays near zero and the terrace never rises. To climb, an attacker must buy real trades from 50 unrelated agents at 2 POA each, so 100 fakes cost 10,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 100 POA once and keeps its fees.
